# tinkoff-ai/ReBRAC (vendored, unmodified subset)

ReBRAC's update and the modules it imports (`src/algorithms/rebrac.py`,
`src/networks.py`, `src/nn.py`, `src/utils/common.py` and
`src/utils/buffer.py`, whose `qlearning_dataset` builds the rows) are
copied unchanged from
[tinkoff-ai/ReBRAC](https://github.com/tinkoff-ai/ReBRAC) at commit
`694385b`. Apache License 2.0, see `LICENSE`. `src/utils/vd4rl_utils.py`
(pixel datasets, dm_control) is left out; the recorder stands in for it.
